territorial_scope.description: Applies to named categories of supervised Peruvian financial, insurance and pension entities and to listed public financial bodies.

evidence.quote: El presente Reglamento es de aplicación a las empresas señaladas en los artículos 16 y 17 de la Ley General

summary.short: Peruvian SBS rule (Resolución 504-2021, in force 1 July 2021) requiring supervised financial, insurance and pension firms to run an information security and cybersecurity management system, with tiered regimes, incident reporting, digital-channel authentication and prior authorization for certain foreign data-processing services.
summary.long: Resolución SBS N° 504-2021 approves the Reglamento para la Gestión de la Seguridad de la Información y la Ciberseguridad for the entities in Articles 16 and 17 of the General Law, AFPs and named public financial bodies (Art. 1). Firms must maintain an information security and cybersecurity management system (SGSI-C) proportionate to their size and complexity, sorted into General, Simplified and Reinforced regimes (Arts. 3-4, 26-27). Duties include board and management responsibilities, a security function, minimum controls, a cybersecurity programme, reporting significant incidents to the Superintendencia and a forensic analysis (Arts. 5-15). Digital-channel transactions require strong authentication, with exemptions for low-risk payments, and the company is responsible for unrecognised operations made under an exemption (Arts. 17-20). Significant outsourced data processing, including cloud services, requires notice 30 days before start (Art. 24.3) and prior authorization for foreign providers where legal limits apply (Art. 25). The rule also amends the internal audit, external audit, corporate governance, operational risk, credit card and e-money regulations (Arts. Second to Eighth). It takes effect 1 July 2021 (Art. Tenth), with an adaptation plan due within 60 days (Art. Ninth).
